module.title: FLEKS embedded particle-in-cell physics in PC and PT slots
entrypoints: test16_2d, test16_3d, test17, test18, test20, test21_4neu, test21_oh_pt, test22_4neu, test22_oh_pt, test23_2d, test23_3d, test25
PC/FLEKS/Config.pl -lev=2 -u=Exo and -amrex2d; the #556 fleks, alfven, fastwave-amr, gmpc, ohpt and swpc-aepic checks
module.expensive_path: The AMReX-based kinetic particle and field update in the FLEKS 2-D/3-D PIC domain, including particle push, collisions/chemistry, AMR and particle-fluid coupling; the 3-D reconnection/performance path is the acceleration candidate.
module.rationale: PC/FLEKS and PT/FLEKS are the same FLEKS source used in two SWMF slots. They are one code family with separate slot configurations and variants, while GM/OH BATSRUS remains a dependency whose MHD physics is not owned here.
excluded: PT/AMPS and the SEP transport codes (swmf-sep)
PC/ALTOR legacy PIC because it does not compile against the pinned share library
hazards: AMReX dimension and level are compile-time configuration; 2-D and 3-D are distinct builds.
The hybrid and boundary variants must be counted as variants of tests, not fabricated independent physics checks.
Coupled FLEKS decks have a BATSRUS run-up; grade the FLEKS observables and keep the MHD dependency explicit.
